description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeaveSearchFilterParams' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Dto'. It extends 'FilterParams' and includes properties and methods to set and get filtering parameters for leave search, specifically a 'leaveRequestId' and sort field settings.

classes.name: LeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for specifying filter parameters when searching for leave requests, with the ability to filter by leave request ID and sort by date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with default sorting by 'leave.date'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the current leave request ID filter value, which can be null or an integer.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter value.
